original.target_description: Original full paper not acquired within the per-paper acquisition window.

replication.target_description: Study 1, exploratory Hypothesis 14: among 2016 Trump voters, college education predicts incorrect selection of the crowd-size photo; chi-square test.

n.sample_role: 2016 Trump-voter participants in the post-exclusion sample; subgroup for Hypothesis 14.
n.exclusions: Excluded survey duration <5 or >60 minutes, age <18 or >100, duplicate IP, and non-USA IP; complete data for 1018 before exclusions.

reported_success.quote: We did not find evidence for this hypothesis

notes: Replication p. 6 locator identifies Hypothesis 14 among Trump voters. The related education analysis among Republicans is Hypothesis 7 on pp. 5–6 (χ²(1) = 0.206, p = .650); it is a distinct sample/test and was not merged. Original paper unavailable. Printed chi-square retained without conversion to OR. Subgroup n is explicitly printed in post-exclusion Materials; no further test-specific exclusions reported.
